sample_unit: unique online resources (Google results, hospital pages, and AI chatbot outputs)

links.outcome: Readability of laryngomalacia parent education materials, including AI chatbot outputs, versus recommended sixth-to-eighth-grade level
links.effect: Only 1 of 19 resources (5.3%) met recommended reading levels; mean FKGL 10.61 (SD 2.24); AI chatbots and Australian hospital websites were particularly inaccessible.
links.quote: 94.7% of laryngomalacia parental education materials exceeded recommended readability levels.

links.outcome: Reading level of parent education materials versus guideline-recommended sixth-to-eighth-grade level
links.effect: Mean FKGL was 10.61 (SD=2.24), exceeding guidelines; Australian hospitals mean FKGL 13.80; UK hospitals 9.45, still above recommendations.
links.quote: Mean FKGL was 10.61 (SD=2.24) across all resources, significantly exceeding guidelines.

screen.reason: Evaluates readability of AI chatbot responses alongside web resources for parents of infants with laryngomalacia.
